userStories.title: Comprehensive Vulnerability & Attack Taxonomy Catalog

userStories.title: Core AST Taint Localization Engine Prototype
userStories.description: Implement a Tree-sitter parser script in TypeScript that analyzes JavaScript/TypeScript files, traces untrusted input variables (e.g. req.body.id), and flags raw string concatenation reaching SQL database query sinks.
acceptanceCriteria: Tree-sitter parser successfully constructs AST for sample controller
Taint analysis algorithm correctly identifies unescaped variable reaching db.query() sink

userStories.title: Z3 SMT Invariant Verification Engine
userStories.description: Implement a formal verification module using the Microsoft Z3 solver that takes a candidate patch and mathematically proves that no execution path allows tainted user bytes to reach the query tokenizer.
acceptanceCriteria: Z3 module initializes with First-Order Logic constraints
Correctly returns SAT for parameterized query patches
Correctly returns UNSAT or generates a counterexample for flawed patches

userStories.title: Autonomous Patch Synthesis & Sandboxed Test Chamber
userStories.description: Integrate code model synthesis with test chamber to verify that patches resolve vulnerabilities without breaking existing test suites.
acceptanceCriteria: Patch synthesizer generates syntactically valid TypeScript/JavaScript diffs
Test runner executes against test suite in isolated environment
Reports test pass rate and execution latency in under 1 second

userStories.title: High-Craft Telemetry Dashboard Integration

acceptanceCriteria: Web dashboard displays side-by-side diff with syntax highlighting

userStories.title: Real Relational SQLite Database & In-Dashboard SQL Studio
userStories.description: Eliminate all mock data confusion by providing an authentic SQLite relational database, live REST API server, CLI inspection tools, and in-app SQL Studio.
acceptanceCriteria: Native SQLite3 database created at data/aegis.db using better-sqlite3 with WAL mode and foreign keys
6 normalized relational tables: scans, vulnerabilities, patches, formal_proofs, test_cases, pr_audit_logs

In-dashboard SQL Studio modal with table tabs, query templates, execution latency, and JSON export
CLI database inspection script accessible via npm run db:inspect
Explicit data provenance badges linking all frontend elements directly to their SQLite records
